prompts.title: 3D Paper Quilling Portrait
prompts.prompt:
Create an ultra-detailed, luxury-quality quilling paper portrait of a young male subject, designed in a richly handcrafted paper-strip style inspired by premium 3D quilling art. The character should appear handsome, masculine, and naturally appealing, with a completely original composition and presence.

Subject Appearance

Depict a charming young man with:

thick, naturally wavy, slightly messy voluminous dark hair
deep expressive eyes
strong, well-shaped eyebrows
a sculpted straight nose
defined cheekbones
a sharp masculine jawline
a well-groomed appearance

His expression should feel warm, confident, and softly smiling, with realistic facial proportions and an attractive charismatic look.

Artistic Style

Render the entire portrait as an intricate handmade quilling artwork, built from thousands of individually shaped paper strips.

Use:

curled strips
rolled coils
folded paper ribbons
layered filigree details
delicate swirling paper forms

The paper elements should remain clearly visible and handcrafted while forming the face, hair, beard, eyes, lips, shadows, highlights, and clothing with realistic depth.

Color Palette

Use a bold and elegant palette that includes:

burnt orange
golden yellow
crimson red
magenta
deep violet
turquoise
electric blue
black
ivory
soft white accents

These colors should be blended artistically throughout the portrait while still preserving a refined premium look.

Hair & Facial Detail

The hair should be especially rich and dimensional, made from layered dark paper strips with flowing curls and subtle colored accents woven through it.

The face should show highly detailed paper construction, with the paper strips shaping:

facial contours
skin texture
eyelids and eyes
nose structure
lips
beard texture if present
light and shadow transitions
Clothing

Dress the subject in an elegant ivory textured shirt or jacket, fully constructed in ornate cream-toned paper filigree.

The clothing should feature refined decorative quilling patterns that add a luxurious contrast to the vibrant face without overpowering it.

Composition
vertical portrait
centered framing
head-and-shoulders composition
face occupying most of the frame
mostly frontal pose
balanced and symmetrical presentation
clean pure white background
subtle soft shadow around the artwork
Finish & Presentation

The final image should feel like a premium gallery-quality paper sculpture portrait, photographed with refined studio lighting.

Emphasize:

crisp paper edges
intricate micro-details
visible curled paper fibers
layered 3D relief
realistic dimensional depth
polished fine-art presentation
extremely sharp high-resolution detail
Signature

Place a tasteful handwritten artist signature at the bottom-right corner reading exactly:

“PromptPlum”

Use a refined black calligraphic style with a thin minimalist underline.

Final Style Keywords

Ultra-realistic quilling paper portrait, handcrafted paper filigree, layered 3D paper relief, intricate curled strips, vibrant fine-art detailing, sophisticated composition, premium studio presentation, masterpiece, 8K detail.

prompts.title: Papercraft Portrait
prompts.prompt: Create a hyper-detailed, origami-style version of a person based on the reference image image_0.png, folded from high-quality paper with crisp, clean edges and a realistic paper texture. Intricate geometric folds capture the character’s iconic shape and expressions. The image features a symmetrical, front-facing bust pose with the subject looking directly forward. Use the same color (skin tone, outfit color, hair color) palette as the reference photo (no black). Place it on a clean white studio backdrop with soft, natural shadows(no objects on the background). A minimalist collectable art aesthetic; ultra-photorealistic; 8k, 1080×1080 square.
